status: exploratory method-feasibility, not an external benchmark
question: Can a fold-relative label-dependency contract distinguish global OOF leakage from valid outer-fold training even when rowwise self-exclusion gives the opposite signal?
data: Own synthetic regression data, 600 rows, 2 categorical features, fixed seed 0..9
intervention: Keep X, outer split, training labels, RNG seeds and hyperparameters fixed; add independent seeded normal noise only to outer-test labels. Compare held-out predictions, not evaluation scores.
endpoints: maximum change in held-out predictions under the intervention
dependency_scope: Trusted, explicit TargetEncoder/Ridge composition; not automatic arbitrary-notebook tracing. Sets overapproximate mathematical influence. Intersections are potential paths until a counterfactual witnesses an effect.
split_scope: Regression, fixed label-independent KFold; no stratified split selection, entity/time leakage, tuning, stochastic nondeterminism or general certification claim.
decision: All safe arms must preserve predictions and global OOF must produce an executable dependency witness. Passing only validates this scoped mechanism; published-detector superiority, novelty, external breadth and TCPR promotion remain untested.
